messages:
marisol: Quick sync re: v1->v2 deprecation comms for partners. We need a partner-facing migration playbook (single page) + localized docs for EMEA/APAC marketplaces. Target publish next Wednesday EOD.
connie: ack. I'll start a concise "what changes for partners" doc that highlights model swaps, embed dims, and SDK payload changes. Will call out Dedicated rollback steps.
ivan: for marketplace partners we also need a short changelog entry and a banner in the console tenant for 30 days. Who owns the console banner?
jess: I can file the console banner PR. Need exact copy and the list of tenant IDs to target. Also confirm timing for staggered banners per region.
marisol: timeline: publish docs Wed 18:00 UTC, banners go live Thur 00:00 UTC, email to partners Fri 09:00 local time. We should coordinate with partner success for manual outreach for top 10 accounts.
connie: on translations - we should only translate the partner-playbook + FAQ (not the whole migration guide). i18n-bot: new translation request created: request_id=tr-7921 for locales [es, fr, ja, ko, de]. ETA 48h.
i18n-bot: status: en source uploaded to crowdin, please tag strings with "partner-playbook".
ivan: note on sample apps: our Next.js + Python starter kits embed `model: "open-embed-legacy"` in env. We must update .env.example and call out vector dim change in README.
jess: will open PRs against 3 sample repos and add compatibility table in README (`model id` / `old dim` / `new dim` / `migration flag`).
marisol: also add a small paragraph for partners that run on-prem: they may need to update pinned weights or pull new bundles. Provide quick rollback snippet.
connie: draft rollback snippet (py):```py
# pin to a legacy model id on Dedicated
client.update_model_pinning(tenant_id="t-123", model_id="open-embed-legacy", pin=True)
```
connie: include note: "only use during incident window; contact infra for weight restoration".
ivan: monitoring: add a short dashboard template for partner ops to watch error rate, token latency, and embed-dim-mismatch alerts (count of vectors with unexpected length). I'll put a Grafana JSON in the docs repo.
marisol: great. who's doing smoke tests? we need a matrix that runs: JS/TS, Python, embeddings, streaming across v1/v2 for the 8 affected models.
jess: I'll add a docs CI matrix job. It will run small end-to-end checks against staging and log failures under /docs/test-results/migration.
connie: legal asked to include a "data handling" blurb in the partner email. I'll add that to the partner-playbook and to the small FAQ.
i18n-bot: translation strings tagged. ETA remains ~48h depending on review.
marisol: owners: playbook (connie), sample updates (jess), redirect map (ivan), console banner (jess), partner outreach list (marisol + partner success). Please add owners to PR descriptions.
jess: PRs opened: redwood/docs#5001 (partner-playbook), redwood/sample-next#82 (env + readme), redwood/sample-py#47 (env). docs-bot: CI pending on all three.
ivan: redirect map draft: /models/open-embed-legacy -> open-embed-1024-v2, /models/chat-legacy -> chat-slim-v2. I'll add this to internal redirects doc and link to it from partner-playbook.
connie: small UX ask: add a short "how to check embed dim" snippet for the console debug tab (copy-pasteable curl).
marisol: add a note for partners using SDKs embedded in mobile apps: remind them to update pinned SDK versions (we're bumping major for param renames).
connie: will add an SDK upgrade table: old SDK versions that tolerate positional args vs new explicit payload.
jess: once CI is green I'll merge and queue the translation tasks. We should not publish banners until translations for partner playbook are ready in at least es/fr/de.
marisol: ok hold banners until translations done. partners in APAC will still get the English banner but email will be localized where possible.
i18n-bot: translations completed for es/fr/de (3 locales). ja/ko pending review.
marisol: outstanding blockers: (1) console banner copy (finalize), (2) CI smoke test green, (3) translations for ja/ko. If anything else pops up, flag here and tag #partner-impact.
jess: banner copy draft: "Notice: we are deprecating legacy v1 model IDs and endpoints. Visit the Partner Migration Guide for details. Read more -> /partner-playbook". cc: @legal for final approval.
connie: legal approved banner copy with minor wording tweak.
docs-bot: CI passed for redwood/docs#5001. redwood/sample-next#82 failed (env mismatch). redwood/sample-py#47 passed.
jess: fixing sample-next env in a follow-up patch.
marisol: thanks all. once sample-next fixed and ja/ko reviews done, proceed to publish Wed 18:00 UTC. I'll coordinate partner success to hold the Friday outreach until after banners are live.
